title: ntn.gps Response Application Programming Interface (API) Schema
description: Response indicating current NTN GPS/GNSS location configuration.

off.description: Returned and `true` if the Notecard does not supply its location to the NTN module (a paired Starnote, or Notecard for Skylo's satellite module). The module relies solely on its own GPS/GNSS.

on.description: Returned and `true` if the Notecard supplies a location it already knows to the NTN module (a paired Starnote, or Notecard for Skylo's satellite module).

samples.title: Notecard Location Not Supplied
samples.description: Response indicating the Notecard does not supply its location, so the NTN module relies solely on its own GPS/GNSS (default).

samples.title: Notecard Location Supplied
samples.description: Response indicating the Notecard supplies a location it already knows to the NTN module.
